+   verify:
+     name: verify
+     runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+     needs: [static, unit, integration, build, e2e, e2e-slice, rls-catalog, openapi-drift]
+     if: always()
+     steps:
+       # One required check to configure in the ruleset, and it cannot pass while any job failed,
+       # was cancelled or was skipped. `needs.*.result` rather than `success()` because a skipped
+       # required job would otherwise be read as success.
+       - name: All checks passed
+         run: |
+           results='${{ join(needs.*.result, ' ') }}'
+           echo "job results: $results"
+           for result in $results; do
+             if [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
+               echo "a required job did not succeed: $result" >&2
+               exit 1
+             fi
+           done
